proof_body:
by
  intro a b c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, B, C, hcol, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    have h1 : dist B C < dist B A + dist A C := dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => hcol (by
      have := hw.collinear
      rwa [show ({B, A, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto] at this)
    have h2 : dist C A < dist C B + dist B A := dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => hcol (by
      have := hw.collinear
      rwa [show ({C, B, A} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto] at this)
    have h3 : dist A B < dist A C + dist C B := dist_lt_dist_add_dist_iff.mpr fun hw => hcol (by
      have := hw.collinear
      rwa [show ({A, C, B} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) = {A, B, C} by ext x; simp; tauto] at this)
    rw [dist_comm B A, dist_comm A C] at h1
    rw [dist_comm C B, dist_comm B A] at h2
    rw [dist_comm A C, dist_comm C B] at h3
    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    have ha : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hb : 0 < b := by linarith
    have hc : 0 < c := by linarith
    set x : ℝ := (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (2 * a) with hx
    have hxa : 2 * a * x = a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by rw [hx]; field_simp
    have hpos : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 - x ^ 2 := by
      have h4 : 0 ≤ (2 * a) ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 - x ^ 2) := by
        have : (2 * a) ^ 2 * (c ^ 2 - x ^ 2) = (b + a - c) * (b - a + c) * ((a + c) ^ 2 - b ^ 2) := by
          have : (2 * a) ^ 2 * x ^ 2 = (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [← hxa]; ring
          linear_combination -this
        rw [this]
        have u1 : 0 < b + a - c := by linarith
        have u2 : 0 < b - a + c := by linarith
        have u3 : 0 < (a + c) ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        positivity
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h4 (by positivity)
    set y : ℝ := Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 - x ^ 2) with hy
    have hy2 : y ^ 2 = c ^ 2 - x ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hpos
    have dBC : dist (!₂[0, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) !₂[a, 0] = a := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ha]
    have dCA : dist (!₂[a, 0] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) !₂[x, y] = b := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
      simp
      rw [show (a - x) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = b ^ 2 by rw [hy2]; linear_combination -hxa]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq hb.le
    have dAB : dist (!₂[x, y] : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) !₂[0, 0] = c := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
      simp
      rw [show x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = c ^ 2 by rw [hy2]; ring]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq hc.le
    refine ⟨!₂[x, y], !₂[0, 0], !₂[a, 0], ?_, dBC, dCA, dAB⟩
    intro hcol
    rcases hcol.wbtw_or_wbtw_or_wbtw with hw | hw | hw
    · have := hw.dist_add_dist
      rw [dAB, dBC, dist_comm, dCA] at this; linarith
    · have := hw.dist_add_dist
      rw [dBC, dCA, dist_comm, dAB] at this; linarith
    · have := hw.dist_add_dist
      rw [dCA, dAB, dist_comm, dBC] at this; linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℝ), (∃ A B C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) ∧ dist B C = a ∧ dist C A = b ∧ dist A B = c) ↔ a < b + c ∧ b < c + a ∧ c < a + b
